historyHelp: Find background exports here. Files and job history expire after 24 hours.
emptyHistory: No background exports match these filters.
background: You can leave this page. Find this export in Export history.

errors.failed: The export could not finish. Refresh the status or prepare a new export.
errors.forbidden: Only the current workspace owner can access this export. Ask the workspace owner for help.
errors.feature_required: Your plan does not include this export. Review your plan or ask a workspace admin.
errors.unavailable: Exports are unavailable. Try again later.
errors.not_found: This export is unavailable or has expired. Prepare a new export.
errors.expired: The download has expired. Prepare a new export.
errors.invalid_export: Check the format and filters, then try again.
errors.idempotency_conflict: The export settings changed. Prepare the export again.
errors.invalid_state: The export has already finished. Refresh its status.
errors.storage_unavailable: Private storage is temporarily unavailable. Refresh the status later.
errors.archive_too_large: The archive exceeded the 1 GiB limit. No partial download is available. Contact support for help.
errors.export_cancelled: Export cancelled. You can prepare a new export.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again to download the export.
errors.export_in_progress: Another workspace export is already active. Open export history to continue it.

title: Export workspace
description: Download a private copy of this workspace’s content and configuration.
entryHelp: Prepare a private ZIP of your workspace’s content and configuration.
scopeHelp: One ZIP containing JSON and CSV for links, QR codes, bio pages and versions, campaigns, tags, domains and analytics aggregates.
limits: One active archive per workspace. The complete ZIP must be no larger than {size} GiB.
deliveryHelp: The archive runs in the background and expires 24 hours after preparation. A ready-email link requires sign-in; you can also download from the job page.
ownerHelp: Available on every plan. Only the current workspace owner can prepare or download this archive.

includes.content: Structured content and configuration in JSON, with spreadsheet-safe CSV files.
includes.analytics: All stored workspace analytics aggregates, including data outside the plan’s analytics view window. Raw visitor events are excluded.
includes.state: Hidden, QR-backing and trashed links, stored QR designs, draft and published bio content, and retained bio versions.
includes.excluded: Authentication records, credentials, password hashes, provider verification secrets and visitor hashes are excluded.
includes.images: Images remain referenced by URL. Image binaries and rendered QR files are not bundled.

activeHelp: An archive is already waiting or running. Continue it, or cancel it before preparing another.

email.pending: The archive is ready. Email delivery is pending; you can download now.
email.sent: The ready link was emailed to your current sign-in address.
email.failed: The ready link could not be emailed. You can still download the archive here.
